description.value:
You use your experience and training as a manager to aggressively compel a foe within 30 feet into believing they've been fired. Roll a @Check[type:deception|against:will] check against the target's Will DC. If you're a leader in the organization, you can roll a @Check[type:diplomacy|against:will] or @Check[type:society|against:will] check instead. The target must be a member of an organization (such a corporation, cult, gang, or military) or working on behalf of that organization. The head of an organization is immune to the effects of Unexpected Downsize.

Critical Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Unfriendly] to all creatures from the same organization to which it wasn't already @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Hostile], even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally for 1 minute.

Success As success, but the effect ends after 1 round.

Critical Failure The target knows you're bluffing and becomes immune to your Unexpected Downsize for 24 hours.
